text_markup: The Runner has no mark and plays {card:Jailbreak} to make a run on HQ. When the run is successful, they draw {card:Virtuoso} with {card:Jailbreak}'s ability. The Runner continues their turn by installing {card:Virtuoso} and playing {card:Carpe Diem}. If {card:Carpe Diem}'s instruction to "identify your mark" results in HQ becoming the mark, the subsequent run it allows will meet the trigger condition for {card:Virtuoso}'s third ability if it is successful. Even though there was a successful run on HQ earlier in the turn, HQ was not designated as the mark at that time, so the run made with {card:Carpe Diem} is the first time the Runner makes a successful run on their mark this turn. The Runner will access 1 additional card when they breach HQ.
